testimonials.text: First, the clear comparison between different types of chemical and radiological agents, their mechanisms, and characteristic symptoms. I also appreciated the detailed discussion of specific antidotes, such as atropine and pralidoxime for nerve agents or hydroxocobalamin and sodium thiosulfate for cyanide poisoning. Another highlight was learning that lifesaving interventions take priority over decontamination in irradiated or contaminated patients.
To serve humanity and I feel very glad that I have chosen this course.
Being a Medical technologist this course would give me the courage to use the knowledge gained by this course during chemical and radiation hazards.
